units.source_text: 非要走到这一步不可吗？

en.t: Did it really have to come to this?

units.source_text: 围棋究竟是什么玩意儿？

en.t: What on earth is Go, anyway?

units.source_text: 我十分同情名人。

en.t: I felt deep sympathy for the Master.

units.source_text: 我想起直木三十五去世之前，

en.t: I remembered the time before Naoki Sanjugo died,

units.source_text: 在他的一篇少有的私小说《自我》中，

en.t: when, in one of his rare I-novels, Ego,

units.source_text: 写了这么一句“我真羡慕下围棋”，

en.t: he wrote the line, "I truly envy people who play Go,"

units.source_text: “说它没价值吧，它是绝对没价值；

en.t: "If you say it has no value, then it has absolutely no value;

units.source_text: 说它有价值吧，它又是绝对有价值”。

en.t: if you say it has value, then again it has absolute value."

units.source_text: 直木一边逗弄猫头鹰，一边说：“你不寂寞吗？”

en.t: As Naoki played with the owl, he said, "Aren't you lonely?"

units.source_text: 猫头鹰啄破了摆在桌面上的报纸，

en.t: The owl pecked holes in the newspaper lying on the desk,

units.source_text: 那张报纸刊登了本因坊名人同吴清源的棋赛。

en.t: and that newspaper carried the Go match between the Honinbo Master and Wu Qingyuan.

units.source_text: 由于名人患病，围棋中途暂停了。

en.t: Because the Master had fallen ill, the Go match had been suspended midway.

units.source_text: 直木试图通过探讨围棋那种不可思议的魅力和胜负的纯粹性，

en.t: Naoki tried, by exploring Go's mysterious fascination and the purity of victory and defeat,

units.source_text: 来思考自己写的通俗文学作品的价值。

en.t: to reflect on the value of the popular fiction he himself wrote.

units.source_text: “……近来，我对这种事渐渐感到厌恶了。

en.t: "... Lately, I have gradually begun to feel disgusted with such things.

units.source_text: 现在已经四点多，今晚九点以前还必须写完三十页稿纸。

en.t: It is already past four, and before nine tonight I still have to finish thirty pages of manuscript.

units.source_text: 可是，我渐渐觉得这都无关紧要，

en.t: But I have gradually come to feel that none of it matters,

units.source_text: 让我有一天的时间来逗弄猫头鹰就可以了。

en.t: and that it would be enough if I had one day to spend playing with the owl.

units.source_text: 我并不是为自己，

en.t: It is not for my own sake,

units.source_text: 谁能知道我为新闻事业和家室操劳了多少啊？

en.t: who could know how much I have labored for journalism and for my household?

units.source_text: 他们又是多么冷酷地对待我啊？”

en.t: And how coldly they treat me!"

units.source_text: 直木埋头写作，死而后已。

en.t: Naoki buried himself in writing and did not stop until death.

units.source_text: 我最初认识本因坊名人和吴清源，

en.t: When I first came to know the Honinbo Master and Wu Qingyuan,

units.source_text: 正是由直木三十五介绍的。

en.t: it was precisely through an introduction by Naoki Sanjugo.
